name: labs/tiagocoutinho__xia-pfcu
title: XIA PFCU-4 filter set and shutter controller
intro: XIA PFCU-4 filter set and shutter controller, adapted from tiagocoutinho/xia-pfcu. It reads `status`, `identity`, `shutter_state` and `remote_control_enabled`; sets `filter_a`, `filter_b`, `filter_c`, `filter_d` and 3 more; runs `set_state`, `start_exposure` and `close_shutter`. `set_state`: open or close a mechanical or electronic shutter in the optical path, reporting the resulting state and, for an open shutter, the open duration. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
